hero_summary: I'm a B.Tech Mechanical Engineering student at CVR College of Engineering, Hyderabad, expecting to graduate in 2027. I turn engineering questions into models, simulations and practical studies.
about_paragraph_one: I'm currently pursuing my B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering at CVR College of Engineering, Hyderabad, with expected graduation in 2027. My interests span mechanical design, CAE simulation and manufacturing engineering.
about_paragraph_two: Whether I'm modelling an engine, analysing a chassis or studying machining, I aim to understand the engineering decisions behind the result—not simply produce a final model.
